title: Ryobi 18V ONE+ 4-Piece Kit + 4Ah & 2Ah Batteries: $249 Delivered/ C&C/ in-Store @ Bunnings
body:
Deal: Ryobi 18V ONE+ 4-Piece Kit + 4Ah & 2Ah Batteries: $249 Delivered/ C&C/ in-Store @ Bunnings

[kingmoron] as i was about to go full ozito, ryobi pulls me back..
[hackups] Ryobi makes you feel good when there's sale discount hits when you need it.
Ozito basically no much profit margin and you can buy anything anytime you want at the same price.
[FTTNope] Hard to tell because it's a limited-time promo kit, but the 4 individual tools are currently $302 if you buy them separately (RRS18, R18CSP, RID18, RDD18), without the batteries or charger
[barg99] hard to find blades…
meh it's ryobi pretty cheap though
[barg99] I have the caulking gun and the nailer, they are great. I'm after some batteries if anyone wants to offload.
[Oliblish] The drills in this set aren't brushless. How much importance should I place in a brushless drill when I do fairly basic to moderate handyman jobs around the home?
[FTTNope] Would depend on the individual model but my brushed-motor R18PD3 drill has never let me down, it's nearly 8 years old
[pinkybrain] How much importance should I place in a brushless drill when I do fairly basic to moderate handyman jobs around the home?
standard brush motor is fine for basic to moderate handyman jobs around the house
but if you can afford it, get the brushless cos it is more efficient, less wear out, does not have the arc smell but more expensive
many home handyman have owned and use the brush motors for many years without any problems..
before the invention of brushless motors.
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/r3CsId9yQxo
[DannyBoy] For the odd job brushed drills are fine. Only really comes down to how hard you use your tool when you come round to a session… 😉
[zaino14] Just picked this up earlier today, heads up looks like you can also get a $40 Bunnings gift card as a Bonus Offer from Ryobi if you buy this kit.
[BNR32] Can't see this bundle in the bonus offers. Can you link it
[zaino14] Haven't tried it for my kit, but was what i was told at the store. I can't see it on the list either so guy might have been wrong.
[kingmoron] https://www.bunnings.com.au/ryobi-18v-one-hp-brushless-compa…
if you just need drill and driver(and brushless) this is $169 after rebate
